page: Microsoft Azure M128-64bds_v3 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the MBDSMediumMemoryv3 family. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8473C processor operating at 4.0 GHz, featuring 32 physical cores and 64 dedicated vCPUs with hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 1024.0 GB of RAM, providing a high resource density of 16.0 GB of memory per core. It includes 410 GB of local storage and supports Premium Storage configurations.

In benchmark evaluations, the server demonstrates strong multi-core CPU performance, scoring 67526.75 in stress-ng multi-core tests and 20300.0 in Geekbench multi-core tests. Its memory subsystem is highly efficient, achieving a top-tier read-only large block memory bandwidth of 366.27 GB/sec. Database operations are a key strength, with Passmark database operations scoring in the top 10% at 35053.55, and Redis SET operations reaching 87.07 million operations per second. The processor's Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX-512) and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) support strong performance in image processing and medium-model LLM inference.

Given its high memory-to-vCPU ratio and dedicated compute resources, this server offers strong qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound enterprise workloads without the overhead of a GPU. The combination of a 1024.0 GB memory footprint, fast memory bandwidth, and local storage makes it highly suitable for large-scale databases, in-memory caching layers, data-intensive web serving, and enterprise-grade virtualization.
